weapons.name: Gnomish Pickaxe
weapons.desc: Swings (24). Breaks obstacle blocks you hit: each drops a coin. Every 3rd swing in a row is a big overhead strike (42).

weapons.name: Blacksmith's First Sword
weapons.desc: Slash hits every enemy in the arc. High damage, slight knockback. Parry: attack while dashing.

weapons.name: Longsword
weapons.desc: Slower, but longer reach, a wider arc and harder hits. Parry: attack while dashing.

weapons.name: Dragonsteel Longsword
weapons.desc: Longsword speed and reach, 46 damage. Every 3rd swing in a row: a heavy slash for 110 that stuns for 1.5 s.

weapons.name: Enchanted Sword
weapons.desc: 40 damage, longsword reach. Every 2nd swing releases a spectral sword that pierces 3 enemies.

weapons.name: 1st Martial Arts Scroll
notes: Reach 46  ·  Arc 90°  ·  Max 2 targets  ·  Spin kick 40
weapons.desc: Punches (24) hit up to 2 enemies at very close range. Double-tap: spin kick (270°, 40 dmg, stun 1 s, big knockback).

weapons.name: 2nd Martial Arts Scroll
notes: Reach 58  ·  Arc 95°  ·  Max 2 targets  ·  Spin kick 55
weapons.desc: Stronger, longer punches (30). The longer you keep hitting the same enemy, the harder you hit (up to +80%). Double-tap: spin kick.

weapons.name: 1st Aura Scroll
notes: Reach 46  ·  Arc 90°  ·  Max 2 targets  ·  Spin kick 40
weapons.desc: Punches (24, up to 2 enemies). Each punch also costs 5 mana and launches an aura fist (18 dmg, pierces 3). No mana = plain punches.

weapons.name: 2nd Aura Scroll
notes: Reach 50  ·  Arc 90°  ·  Max 2 targets  ·  Spin kick 50
weapons.desc: Punches (28). Each punch also costs 6 mana and launches a homing aura sphere (24 dmg). Double-tap: spin kick.

weapons.name: Short Bow
notes: Full charge: 60 in 1 s  ·  Pierces 4 at 2 s
weapons.desc: Hold to charge, release to shoot. Taps are weak. 1 s: heavy fast arrow (60). 2 s: pierces 4 enemies.

weapons.name: Long Bow
notes: Full charge: 95 in 1.4 s  ·  Pierces 6 at 2.4 s
weapons.desc: Slower to charge, hits much harder. 1.4 s: heavy fast arrow (95). 2.4 s: pierces 6 enemies.

weapons.name: Crossbow
notes: Bolt 45 × up to 3  ·  Load 0.5 s each  ·  Pierce 1
weapons.desc: Hold to load up to 3 bolts (0.45 s each). They stay loaded (swaps, rooms). Click to fire ALL loaded bolts at once, 45 damage each.

weapons.name: Mana Bow
notes: Full charge: 105 in 1.2 s  ·  Pierces 5 at 2.2 s
weapons.desc: Stronger than the Long Bow (105 at 1.2 s). Full shots also spend 14 mana on a 2nd arrow, fired right after: a mana arrow (55) that explodes on the first enemy it hits.

weapons.name: Hunter Knife
weapons.desc: Quick short slashes (20), same reach as the starter sword. 50% chance to Injure: bleeding (4 every 0.5 s for 3 s) + 30% slower. While held: +15% speed, dash cooldown -35%.

weapons.name: Tomahawk
weapons.desc: Throw a heavy axe (40) that pierces and knocks back. Enemies knocked into a wall get stunned. It comes back after a moment (or pick it up).

weapons.name: Double Tomahawk
weapons.desc: Two tomahawks (36 each): throw one, then the other. Same pierce, knockback and wall stun.

weapons.name: Winchester
weapons.desc: Old rifle, 2 shots (75 each): pierce many enemies, knockback, slow, and Injured (bleeding). When empty, hold attack 1.6 s to reload.

weapons.name: Crippling Crossbow
notes: Bolt 50 × up to 3  ·  Load 0.5 s each
weapons.desc: Hold to load up to 3 bolts, click to fire them all at once. A bolt hitting an unmarked enemy deals 28, marks and slows it. Bolts hitting a marked enemy deal 50 +60%.

weapons.name: Sunsteel Greatsword
weapons.desc: Huge slow swings (58), very long reach. Every 3rd swing in a row: a heavy slash (130, stun 1.5 s) that also throws 3 sun waves.

weapons.name: Executioner's Blade
weapons.desc: Heavy blade (50). Enemies under 35% HP take DOUBLE damage (bosses +40%). Parry: attack while dashing.

weapons.name: Flamberge
weapons.desc: A wavy knightly greatsword. Wide swings (37) that tear wounds: 35% chance to Injure. Every 3rd swing: heavy cleave (78, stun 0.8 s). Parry: attack while dashing.

weapons.name: 3rd Martial Arts Scroll
notes: Reach 62  ·  Arc 100°  ·  Max 3 targets  ·  Spin kick 75
weapons.desc: Punches (36) hit up to 3 enemies. Keep hitting the same enemy: up to +120%. Double-tap: spin kick (75) + a ring of 8 aura fists.

weapons.name: 3rd Aura Scroll
notes: Reach 54  ·  Arc 95°  ·  Max 2 targets  ·  Spin kick 60
weapons.desc: Punches (32). Each punch also costs 7 mana and launches TWO homing aura spheres (26 each, pierce 1). Double-tap: spin kick.

weapons.name: Iron Knuckles
notes: Reach 50  ·  Arc 90°  ·  Max 2 targets  ·  Spin kick 50
weapons.desc: Slow, heavy punches (38, up to 2 enemies) that stun for 0.3 s. Double-tap: spin kick.

weapons.name: Composite Bow
notes: Full charge: 150 in 1.1 s  ·  Pierces 8 at 2 s
weapons.desc: The strongest bow. 1.1 s: arrow (150) plus 2 side arrows (60). 2 s: all of them pierce 8 enemies.

weapons.name: Repeating Crossbow
notes: Bolt 52 × up to 5  ·  Load 0.3 s each  ·  Pierce 2
weapons.desc: Hold to load up to 5 bolts (0.3 s each). Click to fire them all: 52 each, pierce 2 enemies.

weapons.name: Recurve Bow
notes: Full charge: 46 in 0.7 s  ·  Pierces 3 at 1.5 s
weapons.desc: Quick bow. 0.7 s: fast arrow (46). 1.5 s: pierces 3 enemies.

weapons.name: Bone Tomahawks
weapons.desc: THREE tomahawks (44 each). Pierce, knockback, wall stun, and 60% chance to Injure (bleed + slow).

weapons.name: Machete
weapons.desc: Fast long slashes (34). 65% chance to Injure. Bleeding enemies take +40%. While held: +15% speed, dash cooldown -35%.

weapons.name: Boomerang
weapons.desc: Throw it (22): it curves back on its own right away and hits again on the way back.

weapons.name: Mithril Pickaxe
weapons.desc: Heavy swings (46). Breaks blocks (coins). Every 3rd swing: a huge strike (100, stun 0.8 s) that hits all around you.

weapons.name: Blot Staff
weapons.desc: Slow ink orbs (28) that burst into 4 ink drops (10 each) when they hit.

weapons.name: Warden's Flail
weapons.desc: Swing the ball all around you: hits every enemy within reach (38), huge knockback, short stun. Slow.

weapons.name: Devourer Sword
weapons.desc: 36 damage, wide arc. Every kill has a 30% chance to summon a wormling that hunts enemies for 10 s (max 3). Parry: attack while dashing.

weapons.name: Dorsal Bow
notes: Full charge: 30 in 0.7 s  ·  Pierces 2 at 1.4 s
weapons.desc: Homing arrows. Quick charge: 0.65 s for a full shot (30), 1.4 s to pierce 2 enemies.

weapons.name: Mage Staff
weapons.desc: Hold to keep casting magic bolts (24). Slow but steady. Each bolt costs mana.

weapons.name: Wand
weapons.desc: Hold to fire sparks (12), a bit random. Cheap on mana.

weapons.name: Buckler
weapons.desc: Hold attack to raise. Blocks 40% from the front. Raise right before a hit to parry: stun 2 s.

weapons.name: Tower Shield
weapons.desc: Hold to raise: blocks 60% from the front (you walk slower). Hold 0.7 s and let go: SLAM it into the ground (44 all around, knockback, stun 0.7 s). Dash-attack: shield bash (30, huge knockback, wall stun). Heavy: -10% speed.

weapons.name: Apprentice Tome
weapons.desc: Hold to cast; every cast turns the page: bolt (18) → bolt (18) → 3 sparks (12).

weapons.name: Runed Staff
weapons.desc: Hold to cast runes (30) that pierce 1 enemy. Faster than the Mage Staff.

weapons.name: Crystal Orb
notes: 3 orbs × 18 per touch (every 0.5 s per enemy)  ·  Drains 14 mana/s
weapons.desc: Hold: 3 crystal orbs circle you (18 per touch, drains mana). Let go after 0.4 s: they fly at your aim (26, homing).

weapons.name: Archmage Staff
weapons.desc: Hold to cast fast bolts (34) that pierce 2 enemies. Its bolts borrow the magic of your other weapon.

weapons.name: Meteor Staff
weapons.desc: Very slow, very heavy: a meteor (70) that explodes in a big area.

weapons.name: Grimoire of Stars
weapons.desc: Fast pages: star (36, pierce 1) → 5 stars (22 each) → star nova around you (40). While held: +20 max mana.

weapons.name: Chain Wand
weapons.desc: Hold: fast sparks (16) that jump to 2 more enemies (70% damage each jump).

weapons.name: Flame Tome
weapons.desc: Pages: fireball (26, area, burn) → 3 embers (14, burn) → fire ring around you (30, burn).

weapons.name: Phoenix Orb
notes: 3 orbs × 22 per touch (every 0.4 s per enemy)  ·  Drains 14 mana/s
weapons.desc: Hold: 3 fire orbs circle you (22 + burn). Let go: 3 fireballs (34, area, burn).

weapons.name: Frost Wand
weapons.desc: Hold: ice shards (15) that slow enemies by 35% for 1.5 s.

weapons.name: Tide Tome
weapons.desc: Pages: water bolt (22, push) → a FLOOD wave (28, goes through everything, big push) → 3 ice shards (14, slow).

weapons.name: Glacier Orb
notes: 3 orbs × 20 per touch (every 0.4 s per enemy)  ·  Drains 13 mana/s
weapons.desc: Hold: 3 ice orbs circle you (20 + slow). Let go: 3 ice spears (30, pierce 2, slow).

weapons.name: Gale Staff
weapons.desc: Hold: fast gusts (18) that pierce 1 and push enemies back.

weapons.name: Starfury Saber
weapons.desc: Slashes (38). Every swing also throws a homing star (20). Parry: attack while dashing.

weapons.name: Paper Crane Blade
weapons.desc: Folded steel (34). Every 2nd swing sends 2 homing paper cranes (18 each).

weapons.name: Verdant Blade
weapons.desc: Big slashes (54). EVERY swing fires a green beam (40) that cuts through 4 enemies.

weapons.name: Dusk Edge
weapons.desc: Dark slashes (50). Every swing scatters 3 shadow shards (18 each, pierce 1).

weapons.name: Battle Axe
weapons.desc: Heavy chops (34). The lower your HP, the harder it hits (up to +80%). Heavy: -10% speed while held.

weapons.name: Bloodletter
weapons.desc: Chops (46), up to +100% at low HP. While held: 4% of your damage heals you. Heavy: -10% speed while held.

weapons.name: Ragnarok
weapons.desc: Huge chops (66), up to +100% at low HP. Every 3rd in a row: earth-splitting slam (150, all around you, stun 1 s). Very heavy: -15% speed while held.

weapons.name: Grave Staff
weapons.desc: Hold to cast bone shards (20). While held: enemies you kill have a 35% chance to rise as your skeleton.

weapons.name: Soul Lantern
notes: 2 orbs × 16 per touch (every 0.4 s per enemy)  ·  Drains 11 mana/s
weapons.desc: Hold: 2 souls circle you (16 per touch). Let go: they fly out (24, homing). While held: 6% of your damage heals you.

weapons.name: Book of the Dead
notes: Pages (2.9 casts/s, mana 8): bolt 32 → summon → nova 24
weapons.desc: Pages: bone spear (32, pierce 3) → raise a skeleton → cursed nova (24, hexes and slows everything around you).

weapons.name: Thorn Staff
weapons.desc: Hold: thorns (16) that pierce 1 and slow by 20%.

weapons.name: Bramble Orb
notes: 3 orbs × 14 per touch (every 0.4 s per enemy)  ·  Drains 11 mana/s
weapons.desc: Hold: 3 bramble balls circle you (14 + slow). Let go: 3 thorn spears (22, pierce 2).

weapons.name: Tome of the Wilds
weapons.desc: Pages: 5 thorns (16, slow) → roots where you aim (20, hold 0.9 s) → bloom: heal 10 and hit around you (20).

weapons.name: Hex Wand
weapons.desc: Hold: hex bolts (16). Hexed enemies take 25% more damage from everything for 3 s.

weapons.name: Bubbling Cauldron
notes: 3 orbs × 14 per touch (every 0.4 s per enemy)  ·  Drains 12 mana/s
weapons.desc: Hold: 3 bubbles circle you (14 + poison). Let go: 3 potions that splash (28, area, poison, hex).

weapons.name: Witch's Grimoire
notes: Pages (3 casts/s, mana 8): bolt 26 → bolt 30 → nova 20
weapons.desc: Pages: hex bolt (26) → toxic splash (30, area, poison) → curse wave around you (20, hexes + slows everything).

weapons.name: Boulder
weapons.desc: Very slow, huge smashes (95) at short range. Every hit slows enemies (40%). Dash-attack: it rolls off, piercing enemies (70). Until you pick it back up: fast, wide punches (14, big knockback) and +25% speed. Heavy: -10% speed.

weapons.name: Earthbreaker
weapons.desc: A huge hammer: slow, crushing hits (72). Every 3rd hit in a row: a quake blow (150, stuns 1.2 s). Very heavy: -15% speed while held.

weapons.name: Harp
weapons.desc: Strum a wide wave of sound right in front of you: hits everything in the arc hard (34). Slow to play. Uses mana.

weapons.name: Heart Wand
weapons.desc: Shoots little hearts (9), slowly. 12% chance: Lovestruck for 5-10 s (can't hurt you, follows you), then Heartbreak hits it hard.

weapons.name: Cupid's Bow
notes: Full charge: 85 in 0.9 s  ·  Pierces 3 at 1.8 s
weapons.desc: "My Pretty Valentine". Archer AND mage bow: charged arrows hit hard (85) and fill the love bar (3 hits = Lovestruck). Every other Cupid item: +15% damage, +10% charge speed, love fills faster.

weapons.name: Coal Lump
weapons.desc: Throw lumps of coal (14). Hit enemies get coal dirty for 4 s: slowed 30%, their shots go wild, and fire hurts them twice as much.

weapons.name: Hot Coal Lump
weapons.desc: Red-hot coal (26): coal dirty for 5 s (slowed 35%, wild shots, fire x2) AND set on fire, so the burn hits double.

armor.name: Inkblot Crown
armor.desc: +20 max HP. Defense 8%. Every kill has a 30% chance to drip a friendly ink drop that fights for you for 9 s (max 4).

armor.name: Miner's Helmet
armor.desc: Defense 4%. Broken blocks drop 2 coins instead of 1 and heal 1 HP. +10% Miner damage.

armor.name: Knight Armor
armor.desc: High defense (20%). While holding a Melee weapon: +12% speed, +15% damage.

armor.name: Blacksmith Armor
armor.desc: Defense 28%. Skills recharge 20% faster. Sword attacks +20% damage. Knight weapons attack 20% faster.

armor.name: Prince Armor
armor.desc: Very high defense (35%). +50% coins from every source.

armor.name: Monk Vest
armor.stats: Defense +5%, Attack speed +20%, Dodge +15%, Max mana +25, Mana regen +30%
armor.desc: Low defense (5%). +20% attack speed (+35% with Monk weapons). 15% dodge. +25 max mana, +30% mana regen.

armor.name: Amulet Robe
armor.stats: Defense +15%, Dodge +20%, Max mana +40, Mana regen +60%, Attack speed +20%, amuletDash 1, stunOnHit 1
armor.desc: Def 15%, dodge 20%, +40 mana, +60% regen. +20% atk speed (Monk: +35%, +20% dmg). Dash: 3 s rush. Enemies that hit you get stunned (less if tanky).

armor.name: Training Archer Robes
armor.desc: Defense 12%. Bows and crossbows load 25% faster. Precision weapons +15% damage.

armor.name: Agility Cloak
armor.stats: Defense +8%, Dash cooldown -30%, Skill cooldown -25%, Max mana +30, Attack speed +15%, Charge speed +15%
armor.desc: Defense 8%. Dash -30% and skills -25% cooldown. +30 max mana, +15% attack speed. Precision weapons +20% damage.

armor.name: Dragon Hide Cloak
armor.desc: High dodge (25%), defense 22%. +20% damage with every weapon.

armor.name: Apprentice Hunting Gear
armor.desc: Defense 10%. Hunter weapons +20% damage. Tomahawks come back almost instantly.

armor.name: Camo Cloak
armor.desc: Enemies must be much closer to notice you. Defense 15%, +10% speed. Hunter weapons +20% damage, +30% more while standing still.

armor.name: Solo Hunting Gear
armor.desc: Defense 22%. Reload/loading 30% faster. Hunter weapons +30% damage. Tomahawks come back almost instantly.

armor.name: Mage Robe
armor.desc: +30 max mana. Arcane weapons cost 25% less mana.

armor.name: Archmage Mantle
armor.desc: +50 max mana, +30% mana regen, defense 6%.

armor.name: Storm Sash
armor.stats: Attack speed +12%, Crit +5%, Chain jumps +1, Defense +4%
armor.desc: +12% attack speed, 5% crit. Chain sparks jump to 1 more enemy. Defense 4%.

armor.name: Ashen Robe
armor.stats: Max mana +15, Defense +6%, Burn damage +40%, Burn time +30%
armor.desc: Burning you cause hurts 40% more and lasts 30% longer. +15 max mana, def 6%.

armor.name: Snow Coat
armor.desc: +20 max mana, defense 8%.

armor.name: Noelle's Cloak
armor.desc: +70 max mana (enough for Snowgrave), defense 8%. North Wizard spells and weapons cost 20% less mana.

armor.name: Berserker Hide
armor.desc: +15 max HP, defense 4%.

armor.name: Gravecloth
armor.stats: Max HP +15, Defense +5%, Ally damage +30%, Raise chance +10%
armor.desc: +15 max HP, defense 5%. Your allies hit 30% harder; kills have a 10% chance to rise as skeletons.

armor.name: Bark Armor
armor.desc: +20 max HP, defense 14%.

armor.name: Vine Armor
armor.stats: Max HP +20, Max mana +20, Defense +7%, Mana regen +10%
armor.desc: +20 max HP, +20 max mana, defense 7%. +10% mana regen.

armor.name: Witch Hat
armor.desc: +15 max mana, defense 5%. Your hexes last 50% longer.

armor.name: Titan Ribcage
armor.desc: +30 max HP. Defense 12%. Enemies that hit you have a 30% chance to get caught in a ribcage (25 damage, stunned 1.5 s).

armor.name: Thorn Armor
armor.desc: +15 max HP, defense 20%. Hits you take: 30% chance to bounce half the damage back to the attacker and push it away a little.

armor.name: Brotherhood Armor
armor.desc: +40 max HP, defense 25%. Co-op: you take half of every hit your ally takes, while you are above 50% HP.

skills.name: Minecart
skills.desc: Ride a minecart where you aim for 1.4 s: rams enemies (22, big knockback), bounces off walls twice and smashes blocks. Can't be hit.

skills.name: Lunge
skills.desc: Home through 2 + (your Knight items) enemies, piercing them. 2.5x your weapon hit with a Knight weapon, else 15.

skills.name: Onslaught
skills.desc: Plant your feet: 5 rapid slashes in front (0.6x your sword hit each), the last one with big knockback. Take 30% less damage meanwhile.

skills.name: Kaan Sai
skills.desc: Auto-dash kick into every stunned enemy nearby (max 6), 30 damage each. Nothing stunned? Kicks the nearest enemy.

skills.name: Aura Push
skills.desc: Aura force field: stuns everything nearby for 1 s, very high knockback, low damage (8).

skills.name: Extra Loaded
skills.desc: For 10 s, every shot fires 3 arrows (one right after the other). Costs most of your mana.

skills.name: Prop Target
skills.desc: Set up a training target where you aim. Enemies go for it instead of you until it breaks (90 HP, 8 s).

skills.name: Hog Call
skills.desc: Call hogs that charge your enemies for 12 s: 1 hog for every Hunter item you have equipped (max 5).

skills.name: Lockdown
skills.desc: Slam the cell doors: every enemy within 230 px takes 12 and is locked in place for 1.8 s (bosses only flinch).

skills.name: Burrow
skills.desc: Dig underground for 2 s: move freely, can't be hit. Bursting back up hits everything nearby (35) with big knockback. Press again to come up early.

skills.name: Fireball
skills.desc: Slow fireball that explodes for 30 in an area and sets enemies on fire.

skills.name: Whirlwind
skills.desc: Spin attack: hits every enemy around you for 1.5x your weapon's damage and knocks them back. Slammed into a wall: stunned for 0.8 s.

skills.name: Arcane Barrier
skills.desc: A shield of magic absorbs the next 40 damage (lasts 5 s).

skills.name: Blink
skills.desc: Teleport up to 200 px toward your aim (not through walls). Arriving zaps enemies around you (20).

skills.name: Starfall
skills.desc: MEGA SPELL (130 mana: needs more than the base 100). For 3 s, stars rain on random enemies: 18 strikes, 45 each.

skills.name: Spark Nova
skills.desc: A ring of 12 sparks (14 each) bursts out from you.

skills.name: Thunderstorm
skills.desc: MEGA SPELL (130 mana). For 3 s lightning hits random enemies: 12 strikes, 60 each, short stun.

skills.name: Fire Pillar
skills.desc: A pillar of fire where you aim for 3 s: 12 damage every 0.4 s + burn.

skills.name: Inferno
skills.desc: MEGA SPELL (140 mana). Explode in a huge fire blast around you: 90 damage, burning 5 s, big knockback. The floor keeps burning.

skills.name: Wave
skills.desc: A wide wave (26) that goes through everything and washes enemies away.

skills.name: Hurricane
skills.desc: A whirlwind where you aim for 3.5 s: pulls enemies in (not bosses) and holds them there (light damage: 3 every 0.35 s).

skills.name: Snowgrave
skills.desc: MEGA SPELL (150 mana). Everything on screen freezes, then shatters 1.4 s later: 80 + 35% of its max HP (bosses: 160, short freeze).

skills.name: War Cry
skills.desc: For 6 s: +30% attack speed, +20% damage with a melee weapon (only +10% / +10% with any other weapon).

skills.name: Hunter's Net
skills.desc: Throw a net where you aim: everything inside is held in place for 2 s (bosses: a moment) and slowed after.

skills.name: Dynamite
skills.desc: Throw a stick of dynamite: explodes for 45 in an area.

skills.name: Raise Dead
skills.desc: Two skeletons climb out of the floor and fight for you for 15 s.

skills.name: Soul Siphon
skills.desc: Rip the life out of everything where you aim (30). You heal 40% of it.

skills.name: Army of the Dead
skills.desc: MEGA SPELL (130 mana). Everything that died in this room rises as a skeleton (at least 3, at most 8).

skills.name: Soul Harvest
skills.desc: MEGA SPELL (140 mana). Every enemy on screen loses 60 + 15% of its HP (bosses 60). You heal 25% of it (max half your HP).

skills.name: Vine Snare
skills.desc: Vines grow where you aim for 3 s: anything inside is held (0.5 s at a time), slowed and hit for 6.

skills.name: Healing Grove
skills.desc: A grove grows around you for 5 s: players inside heal 4 HP every 0.5 s.

skills.name: Bear Form
skills.desc: For 8 s: +30 max HP, +30% defense, +25% damage, +10% speed.

skills.name: Wild Growth
skills.desc: MEGA SPELL (120 mana). The whole floor around you grows wild for 6 s: enemies are held and hit (14), players heal.

skills.name: Broom Dash
skills.desc: Fly 260 px toward your aim on your broom (can't be hit on the way).

skills.name: Curse of Frailty
skills.desc: Curse a big area where you aim: hexed for 6 s (+25% damage taken) and slowed.

skills.name: Toil and Trouble
skills.desc: MEGA SPELL (120 mana). For 3 s, cauldrons boil over on random enemies: 15 splashes (30, poison, hex).

skills.name: Aura Dragon
skills.desc: MEGA SPELL (all 100 mana). Your aura takes the shape of a fire dragon that hunts for 5 s, +1 s per Monk item you have equipped (30 per bite + a small burn, can't be hurt).

skills.name: Titan's Wrath
skills.desc: MEGA SPELL (110 mana). The Titan's fist slams where you aim (80, stuns), a shockwave rolls out (35) and ribcages trap up to 4 enemies (40).

skills.name: Bear Trap
skills.desc: Set a trap where you aim (2 at most). The first enemy to step in is snapped: 35 damage and stuck 2.5 s (bosses: slowed).

skills.name: Tomahawk Volley
skills.desc: Throw a fan of 5 tomahawks (22 each).

skills.name: Hawk Strike
skills.desc: A hawk dives at enemies near your aim 4 times (26 each) and MARKS them: marked enemies take +25% damage for 5 s.

skills.name: Apex Predator
skills.desc: 8 s: +25% damage, +20% speed, +15% crit, and every hit MARKS the enemy (+25% damage taken for 5 s).

skills.name: Earthsplitter
skills.desc: Smash the ground: 4 spiky rocks burst out in a line, one after another. Each hits for 90% of your melee weapon's damage (other weapons: 16).

skills.name: Wing Flap
skills.desc: Beat your wings: pushes everything nearby away (6 damage). Enemies that hit a wall take 22 more and are stunned for 1.2 s.

skills.name: Cupid's Flight
skills.desc: A long dash that flies through walls and enemies. Leaves a pink trail for 4 s: enemies on it fill their love bar.

skills.name: Cupid's Book
skills.desc: Read a love poem out loud: every enemy nearby is Lovestruck at once (12 damage). Bosses: the reduced version.

skills.name: Cafézin
skills.desc: A strong little coffee. For 10 s: +25% attack speed, +20% damage, +20% speed. Long recharge.

skills.name: Torch
skills.desc: Throw a torch (30). The enemy it hits catches fire, and the fire jumps to every enemy standing close to another burning one.

skills.name: Mine Train
skills.desc: MEGA SPELL (100 mana). Tracks get laid across the room (straight, the way you aim), then a huge mine train smashes through: 170 to everything in its lane.

items.name: Paper Bomb
items.desc: Thrown toward your aim, explodes for 50 damage. You get 2.

items.name: Sharpening Stone
items.desc: 60 s: Melee attacks +20% damage and 10% chance to crit (2x).

items.name: Pocket Sand
items.desc: Stuns the 3 nearest enemies for 4 s. You get 2.

items.name: Mercury Dip
items.desc: 60 s: arrows and bolts deal +12% damage and slow enemies (movement and attacks).

items.name: Bear Trap
items.desc: Set at your feet. The first enemy to step on it takes 90, is stunned, then slowed. You get 2.

items.name: Mana Candle
items.effect: Mana Candle, 60s: Mana cost -20% (Monk: Mana cost -10%)
items.desc: 60 s: mana costs -30% for Monks, -20% for everyone else.

items.name: Focus Crystal
